description: This source file defines a command handler for paying savings account charges within the Apache Fineract platform. It implements the logic to process a 'pay' command for savings account charges, interacting with the savings account write platform service.

classes.name: PaySavingsAccountChargeCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the process of paying charges on savings accounts based on the 'SAVINGSACCOUNTCHARGE' entity and 'PAY' action.

methods.name: PaySavingsAccountChargeCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to pay a savings account charge by invoking the write platform service with the command's savings ID, entity ID, and the command object.
